title: The Matching Socks Treaty
skyStory: The crescent moon thickens in Libra and starts redecorating. It moved the Big Dipper three inches to the left because the feng shui was off. Jupiter noticed and said nothing. A faint planet in the corner of the sky is wearing mismatched socks, and the moon has opinions. Libra will negotiate a treaty by sundown, possibly with snacks.

reading: Friday energy arrives early and wears flip flops, but the cabin wants you inside for one more hour of focus. Light the metaphorical woodstove and finish something with your name on it. When the smoke curls out the chimney, the whole forest will know you meant business.

Around 4:10 pm you will be tempted to start a brand new idea, gleaming and shiny, the kind that whispers what if we built an app for this. Write it on a scrap of paper. Fold it in half. Put it under the onyx bracelet overnight. If it still glows on Monday, it was real. If not, the Tiger saved itself a weekend.
joel.mission: Wear two socks that are a perfect matching pair, check them at noon, and feel quietly in control of the universe.
joel.omen: A door that closes softly by itself. A loose end is tying itself up; let it.

reading: Your hands will do a lot of talking today. One story will need the full orchestra: sweeping arcs, a tiny pinch for the important detail, a dramatic pause with one finger up. Someone across the room will lean forward without knowing why. That is your doing.

The Wood Rat is gathering supplies for autumn, and that includes ideas. Somebody mentions a book, a recipe, a place to walk, and you tuck it away in your cheek like a seed. By October you will have a pantry full of these. The [[Queen of Pentacles]] nods from her garden, impressed with your filing system.
nancy.mission: Tell one story today that uses at least four distinct hand gestures, and count them afterwards like a proud coach.
nancy.omen: A squirrel carrying something far too big for it. Ambitious plans are fine; just take two trips.

together.text: Draft a ridiculous treaty between your two households on any trivial matter: who invented the better hot drink, the correct way to hang a towel. Sign it with your elements, Fire and Mountain. Libra will witness. Saturn will notarize. Mars will absolutely violate it by Tuesday.

game.intro: Mischief on a Friday. The studio dryer is missing a sock and Mars is the prime suspect. Lend us your best sound effect.
game.prompt: A washing machine eating exactly one sock and feeling very pleased about it.
